rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"In TypeCollector.GetObjectInfo, the change stops two kinds of invalid key input from throwing. After it reports DoNotMixStringAndIntKeys for a property or field, it now skips that member. Before adding a member to intMembers or stringMembers, it now checks whether the key is already present, so a duplicate key no longer makes Dictionary.Add throw after KeysMustBeUnique has been reported. It also changes the condition for flushing deferred non-public-member diagnostics from OR to AND.
